phase: declared before any SVD model forward or output inspection
purpose: Verify a fixed original-author image-to-video pipeline on CPU, measure cost, and examine all frames under reduced spatial resolution.

input.origin: Complete SD1.4 scene/seed43 output from the already recorded prompt pilot. Selected before SVD generation.
input.processing: EXIF transpose, RGB conversion, center crop to output aspect ratio, Lanczos resize; preserve processed PNG, crop coordinates and hashes.

stages.condition: Proceed only if calibration exits zero, wall_seconds*25/4 <= 1500 and peak RSS <= 24 GiB. Record prediction and decision before execution.
Repeat the exact smoke configuration after initial successful pipeline validation; compare initial noise and all postprocessed frame arrays.

observation_plan: Inspect complete contact sheet and playback for each successful request.
Describe cabin/shore/tree identity, framing changes, local deformation, abrupt changes and visible motion.
Retain all requested frames, technical failures, timeouts and costs. Do not replace input based on generated quality.
Describe frame differences as change magnitude. There is no ground-truth target motion for this input.
reproducibility_checks: All weight/config hashes and model/software identity.
Actual video batch/frame/channel shape, K UNet calls and 2K conditional video branches.
fps7 input versus internal condition6 and actual exported 7fps timestamps.
Separate initial-video and image-augmentation random streams; actual frame guidance vector and full temporal decode chunk.
Input cropping/hash and complete postprocessed float32 array/PNG hashes.
scope: 144x256 is one quarter of trained 576x1024 in each spatial axis. Four-frame smoke also changes trained fourteen-frame context. Watercolor input is a specific synthetic example. No quality ranking, training reproduction or general video capability estimate is planned.
implementation_identity: Record the completed inference source SHA and git commit in a separate preflight record before the first model call.
